characters.name: Foxy
characters.appearance: small orange fox with a fluffy tail and a bright green knitted scarf

scenes.setting: snowy forest at dawn, soft blue and pink light

shots.description: Wide shot of a snow-covered forest, foxy tiptoeing carefully between frosted trees
Medium shot of foxy's paws making delicate prints in the fresh snow

scenes.setting: edge of the snowy forest, clearing with a frozen pond

shots.description: Foxy peeks through a snow-laden bush, eyes widening as it sees a large, smooth frozen pond
Close-up of foxy's curious face, nose twitching, then looking down at the gleaming ice

scenes.setting: frozen pond, surrounded by snowy trees

shots.description: Foxy tentatively steps onto the ice, slipping slightly, then gaining balance
Wide shot of foxy playfully sliding and spinning across the smooth, frozen pond, scarf fluttering
